children: WASHINGTON (dpa-AFX) - Netflix Inc. (NFLX) revealed a profit for its third quarter that Increased, from last year
The company's bottom line came in at $3.664 billion, or $0.87 per share.  This compares with $2.547 billion, or $0.59 per share, last year.
The company's revenue for the period rose 11.9% to $12.874 billion from $11.510 billion last year.
